newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Hua Fei Colour Display sets $200 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Hua Fei Colour Display sets $200 mln loan.

text.p: The following US$200 million syndicated loan issue was announced by arranger CCIC Finance on Thursday.
The borrower is a Sino-foreign joint venture which manufactures colour TV picture and monitor tubes. It is based in Nanjing, in the eastern province of Jiangsu.
Shareholders are Philips Electronics China BV with 55 percent, China National Huadong Electron Tube Factory with 27 percent and Jiangsu Province Investment Co with 18 percent.
Proceeds of the loan will be used for plant expansion. Details are as follows:
